name: fmp_dowjones_constituents
description:
Current constituents of the Dow Jones Industrial Average from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): symbol, name, sector and related fields.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/dowjones-constituent as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Other indexes: fmp_sp500_constituents, fmp_nasdaq_constituents; index level: fmp_index_quote.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
